India's Test Squad Changes and Player Preparations for Sri Lanka Series

The Indian cricket team has announced squad changes for the upcoming two-match Test series against Sri Lanka, scheduled to begin on August 15. Jasprit Bumrah has been replaced by a bowler who has taken 261 wickets. Additionally, two extra spinners will accompany the team to Sri Lanka to aid batsmen in preparing for spin conditions. Players like Rishabh Pant, KL Rahul, and Yashasvi Jaiswal have been undergoing special training sessions. Ravindra Jadeja is also on the verge of a significant bowling milestone, being two wickets away from a record previously unachieved by Indian bowlers like Kumble, Ashwin, and Harbhajan.
